newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Monday 90,000 -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Monday 90,000 -USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog receipts Monday were 90,000 head, compared with 91,000 a week ago and 95,000 a year ago, USDA said. Estimates include generally about 65 percent Carcass Base Hogs.
Barrows and gilts $1.00 per cwt higher than the midsession Friday. Trade slow for good demand and light offerings. Hot Humid weather slowing hog movement.
Sows: 500 dn steady to 1.00 higher, 500 up generally steady.

Note: Prices quoted represent sales of hogs averaging 73-74 pct carcass yields with mostly 1.00-1.25 inches of last rib backfat and 47-48 pct lean. Special considerations and grade premiums not reflected in base prices.
